latest_verified_github_release.scope: Previously released PR211 package; rollback baseline for the new grid candidate.

cross_grid.intended_feature: Optional map reference overlay with numbered cross-to-cross cells and fractional positions.

approved_coverage.scope: Optional Atlas-owned native-image reference grid; alignment residuals apply to recorded measured samples only.

domain.measured_bounds_note: Bounds enclose sampled nodes, not every node. A1 itself was too faint to measure. Native error statistics apply only to measured nodes; the conventional grid extends beyond the measured bottom row.
domain.edge_policy: Clip each cell polygon to native image bounds. Row18 and columnR are partial edge cells. The narrow top/left strips before A1 have no labelled cell. Do not assign points outside image bounds or negative grid indices.

cross_grid.origin_and_spacing_rule: Directly fit19native crossings; ten outer and ten interior crosses withheld. Independent numerical review reproduced the affine and supporting local architecture fits. A1 is a model-defined reference origin, not an official game origin.

cell_convention.numbering_origin: Model-defined northwest reference crossing A1; columns A–R increase east, rows1–18 increase south.
cell_convention.uncertainty: Keep error bounds and adjacent-cell ambiguity; coordinate decimals do not establish accuracy.
cell_convention.cell_labels: The northwest crossing names its cell. Half-open boundary assignment uses the cell east/south of an exact line.
cell_convention.fractional_precision_scope: Display precision does not improve measured source or marker accuracy.

approximate_60_scale.owner_observation: Roughly 60 walking steps between adjacent crosses, repeatedly reported by Trev.
approximate_60_scale.video_observation: Waypoint display reads 60 around 20.9–21.0 seconds in the preserved recording.
approximate_60_scale.endpoint_limitation: Partly obscured player/pin endpoints prevent an exact one-cell physical-distance conversion.
approximate_60_scale.use: The runtime uses ten visual subdivisions per cell. Sixty remains the owner report/waypoint observation and is not used as a feet/metres/step conversion.

camera.diagnosis: The prior clamp used the rotated square bounding box only. At high zoom and diagonal rotation/pan it could allow the actual map polygon to leave the viewport.
camera.repair: Retain existing screen-axis clamps and also require positive overlap against both map-edge axes; reduce only violating extreme translations.
camera.validation_scope: The local workflow Node file list passes134tests with zero failures; desktop managed-preview observations pass. Exact-head GitHub CI and phone validation remain pending.
